# Food & Drink MCP connectors

2 food & drink connectors for AnythingMCP. Each one gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini the MCP tools of one system, on [AnythingMCP Cloud](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com) or on your own server ([run it yourself](../../README.md#run-it-yourself)).

The links open the setup guide for each connector and assistant on anythingmcp.com, in seven languages. All food & drink connectors: [anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/food](https://anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/food).

| Connector | What it does | Tools | Setup guides |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Fudo](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/fudo-to-mcp) | Fudo restaurant point of sale: sales and tickets with items and payments, payments and payment methods, customers, products and menu categories, expenses with their purchased lines, expense payments … | 34 | [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-fudo-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-fudo-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-fudo-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-fudo-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-fudo-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-fudo-to-muse) |
| [Resy](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/resy-to-mcp) | Search Resy restaurants from any AI assistant. | 6 | [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-resy-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-resy-to-chatgpt) · [Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-resy-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-resy-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-resy-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-resy-to-muse) |
